description.text:
The deck that won the Senior Division of the 2025 World Championships, an unexpected take on Gholdengo ex. Joltik floods the board with Energy, Iron Hands ex and Pikachu ex attack early, Gholdengo ex moves in and out of the Active Spot, where its Coin Bonus draws an extra card, and Superior Energy Retrieval brings the Energy back. The 2025 World Championships were held from 15 to 17 August 2025 at the Anaheim Convention Center in Anaheim, California, which had also hosted them in 2017.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2025 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
